messages:
joel: hi all, i'm joel (data infra). onboarding day 1. Okta is asking me to enroll MFA but i don't see the "Set up" option after signing in, just 'Verify'. stuck. any ideas?

it-bot: Ticket IT-2188 created for @joel. If this is urgent, run `/pager marie`.

marie: welcome @joel! quick check: are you signing in with the company email or a forwarded alias? sometimes alias accounts only get Verify and not full setup. also which browser/device?

joel: signing with primary company address on macOS, chrome. no alias.

marie: ok. two fast experiments: 1) try the private window flow (incognito) to avoid extensions; 2) check the Okta portal (https://redwood.okta.com) -> avatar -> Settings -> Extra Verification to see if a factor exists. if there's a pending factor we can clear it from admin.

joel: tried incognito, still only 'Verify'. checked settings and there's a ghost factor listed that i can't remove.

marie: i'm resetting your factors now and reissuing the 1Password invite. give me ~10min.

devops-bot: Resent 1Password org invite to joel.

marie: reset done. try signing in and you should see 'Set up' for Okta Verify, or you can click "Can't scan?" and do Manual Setup and add the OTP to 1Password.

joel: manual setup worked after reset and 1Password invite arrived. email and slack access good. thanks y'all! :thumbsup:
